caption_L1: Number of strong earthquakes in the U.S. from 1974 to 2003 , by state is a bar chart. The y-axis plots Number of earthquakes on linear scale from 0 to 12,000 while the x-axis measures State on categorical scale with Alabama on one end and Wyoming at the other.
caption_L2L3: From 1974 to 2003, Alaska had the highest number of strong earthquakes in the US with the number of 12000 earthquakes, California had the second highest of over 4000 earthquakes, along with Hawaii, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, Utah, Washington and Wyoming having less than 2000 earthquakes.
